name: bootstrap_n
description: number of case-bootstrap resamples (conditions drawn with replacement)

name: bootstrap_chunk
description: resamples fitted per chunk (a checkpoint is written after every chunk)

name: bootstrap_ci_ratio_max
description: practically identifiable: 97.5/2.5 percentile ratio at most this

name: bootstrap_frac_at_bound_max
description: practically identifiable: fraction of resamples on a theta bound below this

name: bootstrap_ci_span_max
description: practically identifiable: CI span over the bound span (log10) below this

name: profile_half_points
description: profile likelihood: steps per arm (an arm has this + 1 points; the anchor is point 0)

name: profile_span
description: profile likelihood: half width in decades around the anchor

name: loocv_n_starts
description: LOOCV: multistart size of a fold that does not reach the bound
